lines.text: Many learners say: It depends from the weather.
Better: It depends on the weather.

native.tip: После depend ставь “on”: “It depends on the weather”.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “It depends from the weather.”? 😅 Русское «зависит от» тянет за собой “from”, а нужно “on”. Правильно: “It depends on the weather.”. Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “on”. После depend всегда on. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: After depend, use “on”: “It depends on the weather”.
en.caption: Do you also say “It depends from the weather.”? 😅 Russian “zavisit ot” pulls in “from”, but you need “on”. Correct: “It depends on the weather.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
